compat.text: If the membrane does not adhere to other elements, lift and retorch the unbonded areas. 1. IMPORTANT Application at less than +5 °C When applying the membranes at temperatures lower than +5 °C
compat.heading: APPLICATION

compat.text: Unroll the membrane. 1. Align the membrane. 2. Re-roll the membrane before application. 3. MEMBRANE OVERLAPS Overlap the membranes by a minimum of 100 mm on the sides and 150 mm on each end or as specified by the supplier. 1. At the end overlap, cut off a corner measuring 100 mm per side at an angle of 45°. 2. TORCHING Heat the substrate and the backing film on the underside of the membrane with a gas burner. 1. When the backing film starts to melt, the membrane is ready to stick. 2. Roll the heated membrane forward and press it firmly against the substrate to bond it. 3. Make sure a bead of melted bitumen is visible along the full length of the overlap sides and ends when laying. 4. Suitable substrates for torching Concrete
